svg.aria-label: A 2 m by 1 m plate divided into four rectangles of unequal size by node lines at x = 0, 0.7 and 2.0 m and y = 0, 0.4 and 1.0 m, nodes numbered 1 to 9 from the bottom left. Rollers on the left edge stop the horizontal displacement, a pin at node 1 also stops the vertical one, and a uniform tension sigma zero pulls on the right edge.
